verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents a Raw Event Export API that returns raw events as JSONL with all properties and is recommended for high-volume exports. It also documents a Query API that returns the same calculated results as web reports (event filtering and breakdowns, profiles, activity streams, cohorts), plus JQL for custom JavaScript queries. A community comment praising the export policy offers light corroboration. Missing for 10: hands-on corroboration that the query/export endpoints work as documented, and a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404).
